cohort: The study examined 267 women with infertility who planned pregnancy using ART, divided into groups based on IVF failure or success, and compared them to a group of pregnant women after IVF (male factor) and a control group of women with physiological pregnancy.
finding: The study found a significantly higher frequency of aPL circulation in women experiencing IVF failures (42.1%) compared to those who achieved pregnancy with ART (19.1%), women with IVF due to male factor (6.3%), and control pregnant women (3.4%).
cross-section timing: The study compared aPL circulation in women whose IVF outcomes (failure or success) had already occurred.
